title: Riftweave cRPG Ruleset Root Schema
description: Root schema referencing all rule data types. Each data file in the ruleset should reference its specific schema via $schema.

ability.description: Core attributes (1-10 scale): Strength, Perception, Endurance, Intelligence, Willpower, Agility, Charisma, Luck

diceExpression.description: Polyhedral dice notation used for damage and similar rolls, e.g. 1d8, 2d6+3. Resolution (skill/attack checks) uses d100 roll-under, not this.

percentile.description: A d100 roll-under value (skill rating, chance, or resistance), normally 0-100 but allowed above 100 for buffed/legendary values.

color.description: Color magic school. The governing skill is <color>_magic.

phase.description: Wuxing (five-phase) five-phase tag. Governs how an effect INTERACTS with other effects via the generating/overcoming/insulting/weakening cycles (see data/wuxing). Orthogonal to color: color picks the governing <color>_magic skill, phase picks the elemental relationship. Omit for non-elemental effects, which do not participate in the cycles.

damageType.description: Canonical damage tag. Keys match ruleset/data/combat/damage_types.json. cold is not a key: use frost. lightning is not a key: use shock. Do not add a second vocabulary.

qualityGrade.description: Crafting quality ladder, listed lowest to highest (common is the baseline). Shared vocabulary reused across crafting conventions (gems, and future components).

appliedEffect.description: An instance of an effect drawn from the effect registry (data/effects), with its applied magnitude and duration. Shared by spells, consumables, ingredients, and enchantments. Use 'parameter' for generic effects (e.g. fortify_skill with a specific skill key, fortify_attribute with an ability, restore_resource with 'health'/'stamina'/'mana', resist with 'fire'/'poison'/'undead'/'magic'/'physical', cure with a condition, summon with a type).

effect.description: Effect reference: namespaced format core:effect/<key> (e.g. core:effect/damage_fire)

magnitude.description: Effect strength; interpreted per the effect's magnitudeUnit

duration.description: Seconds the effect runs; 1, the default when omitted, is instant. Magnitude is always the amount per second: a pool effect (restore, damage, drain) applies it each second, so the total is magnitude times duration; a stat effect (fortify, resist) holds it for the duration. On a worn item (enchantment, accessory) a stat effect holds while equipped and takes no duration; an on-hit effect uses its duration per hit.

target.description: Delivery shape (used by spells); omit for consumables/ingredients, which apply to the user

radius.description: Area radius in units (grid squares, docs/core/contract.md#distance) when target is 'area'

parameter.description: For generic parameterized effects (fortify_skill, fortify_attribute, restore_resource, resist, cure, summon, phobia, etc.), specifies the subject. Use namespaced key (core:category/<key>) when referencing another collection (e.g. core:skill/<key> for fortify_skill), or vocabulary (e.g. 'health', 'fire', 'all', ability codes, creature categories).

origin.description: The origin its modifiers carry (core:origin/<key>), when it is not the default for the row's category: a divine spell, holy water. docs/core/modifier.md#origin.

durationType.description: For fortify effects (especially on skills/attributes): 'unlimited' effects are normally stackable (magnitudes add). 'temporal' effects of the same type (same effect id + parameter) override each other, taking the highest magnitude as the effective value (and usually the longest duration).

creatureCategory.description: Standard categories used for phobias, creature-specific effects, and interactions (e.g. in generic 'phobia' effects). Common values: undead, beast, construct, humanoid, dragon, spirit, aberration, plant, ooze. These are string cross-references and not strictly schema-enforced.

modifier.description: One opcode on one target. Order for a target, expiry, origins, and conditions: docs/core/modifier.md. Same origin, source, target, and operation does not stack (the strongest wins); different sources add unless they share a highest origin; add, then multiply (floored), then set; grant adds a flag; resist subtracts from a packet with the matching tag.

target.description: A key naming one row: an attribute, a skill, a derived stat, an action (its AP cost), a condition (its flag), a damage type (for resist), or a row of modifier_targets. validate.py checks that it resolves and that the op fits its kind (docs/core/modifier.md#target).

operation.description: What the modifier does to its target (docs/core/modifier.md).

duration.description: When the modifier ends. while_applied and while_equipped end with their source; turns ends after `turns` elapsed turns; uses is counted by the caller; permanent never ends.

turns.description: How many turns a `turns` modifier lasts.

origin.description: The kind of source: core:origin/<key> (ruleset/data/origins). Its policy decides whether modifiers of this origin on one target and op stack (add) or only the strongest bonus and penalty count (highest). Omitted: stacks by source alone. docs/core/modifier.md#origin.

stack.description: none: same source does not stack. add: different sources add.

namespacedRef.description: A cross-reference to another entry: core:<singular-category>/<key>, or module:<module>/... for module content (docs/core/keys.md). A bare string is not a reference.

backgroundRef.description: A reference to a background row (docs/core/integrity.md).

checkRef.description: A reference to a check row (docs/core/integrity.md).

conditionRef.description: A reference to a condition row (docs/core/integrity.md).

craftedItemRef.description: A reference to a crafted_item row (docs/core/integrity.md).

effectRef.description: A reference to a effect row (docs/core/integrity.md).

heldPerk.description: A perk an actor holds, at a rank (M3-15): at most the perk's ranks, 1 when left out.

featureRef.description: A reference to a feature row (docs/core/integrity.md).

gemRef.description: A reference to a gem row (docs/core/integrity.md).

ingredientRef.description: A reference to a ingredient row (docs/core/integrity.md).

materialRef.description: A reference to a material row (docs/core/integrity.md).

creatureTypeRef.description: A reference to a creature type in monsters/bases/ (docs/core/keys.md).

equipmentBaseRef.description: A reference to a base template in equipment/bases/ (docs/core/keys.md).

monsterRef.description: A reference to a monster row (docs/core/integrity.md).

monsterTemplateRef.description: A reference to a monster template in monsters/templates.json (docs/modules/monsters.md#templates).

naturalWeaponRef.description: A reference to a natural weapon in natural_weapons/core.json (docs/modules/monsters.md#natural-weapons). Not equipment.

originRef.description: A reference to a origin row (docs/core/integrity.md).

raceRef.description: A reference to a race row (docs/core/integrity.md).

skillGroupRef.description: A reference to a skill group row, for the grouped sheet (docs/core/progression.md#the-grouped-sheet-variant).

summonBonusRef.description: A reference to a summon bonus in summons/bonuses.json (docs/modules/magic.md#summon-groups).

skillRef.description: A reference to a skill row (docs/core/integrity.md).

spellRef.description: A reference to a spell row (docs/core/integrity.md).

itemRef.description: A reference to an equipment row of any category (docs/core/integrity.md).

formulaNode.description: A formula tree node (docs/core/formula.md): a leaf (literal, attribute, variable) or an operation over arguments. Integer only.
